title: Observability Spotlight: Walkthrough canvas and compact screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, narrative-driven set of onboarding screenshots and accompanying canvas artifacts that showcase latency, cost-per-token, and trace/span views for the Console quickstart. Deliver both hero frames for docs and a set of small-step screenshots suitable for the product tour and in-app onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero screenshots exported at 1920x1080: latency-over-time, cost-per-token breakdown, and a detailed tracer view with span labels

Six compact micro-tiles (640x360) showing stepwise exploration: filter by model, compare lanes (hosted/dedicated/private), zoom into single-request trace, show KV cache hit overlay, and highlight cost delta after batching
All screenshots use current Console tokens/theme and copy approved by PM
Figma canvas contains layered components and export-ready naming conventions; dev/ops can reference exact asset filenames
Design handoff includes CSS-safe color swatches, accessible contrast notes, and suggested alt text for docs
tasks: Audit existing observability assets and compile differences vs console-2026.03 theme
Design hero canvas that tells a short story: identify latency regression -> show trace -> quantify cost impact
Create compact micro-tile variants for in-product coach marks
Iterate with PM and Eng on accurate metric labels and timeframe defaults (1h, 24h, 7d)
Prepare Figma exports and upload to Drive; name assets per export convention
Write short captions / alt text for docs and quickstart snippets
screenshot_variants: hero_latency_waterfall_1920x1080 - waterfall + percentile bands + callout highlighting 95th percentile
hero_cost_per_token_1920x1080 - stacked bar by model family + token unit price overlay
hero_trace_span_1920x1080 - single request flame/span view with KV cache hits annotated
tile_latency_filter_640x360 - filter dropdown open for environment (hosted/dedicated/private)
tile_cost_after_batching_640x360 - before/after cost sparkline with percent delta
tile_kv_cache_overlay_640x360 - trace with KV hit/miss ribbon
